scope: Aggregate external Game 1 development and frozen previously inspected Game 2 diagnostic; no frame-level data.

game1.negative_diagnostic: In 5-second known-live gaps, recovery-instant accuracy drops by one of 192 references in both tag modes, within the unchanged guard.

game2_frozen_diagnostic.interpretation: Nonnegative but negligible scored change; not an unseen holdout.

decision: Keep the candidate opt-in. It clears the original 60 Game 1 and 60 previously inspected Game 2 guards with a modest development gain, but does not establish challenge accuracy or resolve inherited active-parameter provenance.
limitations: Four-frame same-player contact is an external development choice, not independent physical-touch ground truth.
A team-only slot fallback added only one reception at the eight-frame contact minimum; a 2 m/s relative-speed gate suppressed most receptions, so neither is active.

Bounded decoding only changes live H/A frames between observed source-derived contact and reception/turnover when both contacts agree with the baseline. It cannot repair unsupported recoveries or missing-ball periods.
Provider reference events score and diagnose predictions but are never features for no-tag inference.
Game 1 is development and Game 2 was previously inspected; neither is an unseen holdout.
Detailed frame-level reports remain ignored locally; old global-phase studies retain their original code hashes.
